description: This file defines the InlineJdbc class, a Java class that models the <inline-jdbc> element within an entity configuration XML in the OFBiz framework. It encapsulates various JDBC connection and pool configuration parameters, providing validation and accessor methods.

classes.name: InlineJdbc
classes.description: A class representing the <inline-jdbc> configuration element, encapsulating JDBC connection details and connection pool parameters.

methods.name: getJdbcDriver
methods.description: Returns the JDBC driver class name.

methods.name: getJdbcUri
methods.description: Returns the JDBC connection URI.

methods.name: getJdbcUsername
methods.description: Returns the JDBC username.

methods.name: getJdbcPassword
methods.description: Returns the JDBC password.

methods.name: getJdbcPasswordLookup
methods.description: Returns the JDBC password lookup key.

methods.name: getPoolMaxsize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the connection pool.

methods.name: getPoolMinsize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the connection pool.

methods.name: getIdleMaxsize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of idle connections.

methods.name: getTimeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis
methods.description: Returns the interval between eviction runs in milliseconds.

methods.name: getSoftMinEvictableIdleTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns the soft minimum evictable idle time in milliseconds.

methods.name: getPoolSleeptime
methods.description: Returns the sleep time between pool maintenance operations.

methods.name: getPoolLifetime
methods.description: Returns the lifetime of a connection pool.

methods.name: getPoolDeadlockMaxwait
methods.description: Returns the max wait time for deadlock detection.

methods.name: getPoolDeadlockRetrywait
methods.description: Returns the retry wait time for deadlock detection.

methods.name: getPoolJdbcTestStmt
methods.description: Returns the JDBC test statement used for validation.

methods.name: getTestOnCreate
methods.description: Indicates whether to test connections upon creation.

methods.name: getTestOnBorrow
methods.description: Indicates whether to test connections when borrowed.

methods.name: getTestOnReturn
methods.description: Indicates whether to test connections when returned.

methods.name: getTestWhileIdle
methods.description: Indicates whether to test connections while idle.

methods.name: getPoolXaWrapperClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for the XA wrapper.
